_doc: Task 53 physical acts on people (scripts/systems/person_acts.gd). Offered on anyone the pawn can reach; nothing in the menu says how it will go. close: the pawn walks up to them first. check: the SkillCheck act (opposed by the target's skill there). Each act: what the target feels (victim_buff), what it is on the record if it's reported (charge: assault | theft | robbery | threats | harassment, sev), and the noise / visibility for witnesses (Notice). The target's reaction is drawn from notice.json reactions.person.victim, a witness's from reactions.person.passerby. coins: [min, max] taken (never more than they have). needs: what the pawn must have on them (phone).

pickpocket.label: Pick their pocket
line_fail: {t} feels the hand in the pocket.

grab_bag.label: Grab their bag
line_ok: You snatch the bag and run: {c} coins in it.

demand_money.label: Demand their money
line_ok: {t} hands over {c} coins with shaking hands.
